note: The Shire market directory lists "Hill & Ridge Community Market, Red Hill" at "184 Arthurs Seat Road", described as "A gathering of good things in the heart of Red Hill". Read first hand on 2026-09-14. Recorded as corroboration independent of the organiser, and as evidence for register item A25: the landholding council names Hill & Ridge as the Red Hill market and names no other. It does not state anything about the Red Hill Community Market, and nothing about that market is inferred from its absence here.
